Oh, absolutely. Why bother with the tedious, sweaty, and frankly unglamorous act of actual exercise when you can just aggressively shake a piece of plastic until your arms fall off? It’s the ultimate hack. I mean, if a Greek statue took years of sculpting, why should I take more than ten minutes? Efficiency is key, after all.

As for my dental hygiene, I’ve found that the same logic applies. I don’t believe in brushing. That’s so last century. Instead, I simply shake my mouth vigorously for ten minutes a day. It’s the epitome of effortlessness. Why scrub for hours when a few flicks of the jaw can polish your teeth to a blinding, blinding shine? It’s not just a routine; it’s a lifestyle choice that prioritizes wrist health over cavity prevention. Truly, the fitness industry has blessed us with the concept that one can simply shake a plastic dumbbell for ten minutes a day to achieve an enviable physique. It's the epitome of effortlessness: why sweat for hours when a few flicks of the wrist can carve your body into a Greek statue?
